title: IRT Growth Curves, Lag-CRP, and PLI Recency

answers.student_hint: IRT growth curves for LTP093 (sessions 0-22): mean IRT (ms) per (total correct on the list, transition position), one row per cell, sorted by Total Correct then Transition Position

between-subject IRT growth curves over the 24-session cohort (session 23 dropped): mean of the subject-level IRTs (ms) per (total correct, transition position), sorted by Total Correct then Transition Position
Lag-CRP for LTP093 session 0 only: conditional response probability at each lag (-23..23), NaN at lag 0
Lag-CRP for LTP093 pooled over sessions 0-22 (lags -23..23, NaN at lag 0)
Lag-CRP per subject of the 24-session cohort (session 23 dropped), lags -23..23, sorted by subject then lag; seaborn averages across subjects

PLI recency curve restricted to lists 10-24: per-subject proportion of the PLIs from 1-9 lists back that came from list_lag lists back, sorted by subject then list_lag (seaborn averages across subjects)
